description: Use this when someone asks for a kind of game by theme or keyword rather than by group size, for example football, racing, fighting, horror, quiz or trivia, bluffing, impostor, drawing, dance or motion, zombies, pirates, music. Returns matching PadConsole games with links. Does not start a game.

locale.description: Language the user is writing in: tr (Turkish), de (German) or en (everything else). Default en.

max_results.description: How many games to return. Default 5.

players.description: Optional group size (1-12) to filter by.

query.description: Theme or keywords in any language, e.g. 'football', 'korku', 'Quiz'.

name: search_games
title: Search games by theme
